title: Over Legends
description: A mod for those who want to make the game more hard
body:
Over Legends brings new mythical power to your Minecraft world!
Discover the mysterious Fire Agate, a rare gem capable of crafting powerful weapons or enhancing your Netherite sword beyond its limits.

⚡ Features:

Fire Agate – A new gemstone used to forge the mighty Fire Agate Sword or upgrade your Netherite Sword.

New Enchantments:

Zeus – Unleash the power of thunder with every strike.

Storm – Command the skies and rain destruction upon your foes.

New Mob:

Runner – A fast, green, four-legged creature that hunts you down. Don’t let it catch you!
